items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there were people like um...Lamont Hamilton, who played tenor [saxophone], Moon Mullins [sp.]–both of which lived on the west side–um...Johnny Trafton.

ctx.x: And you, you were there. People like Tommy Flanagan–we could just name tons of people–Paul Chambers, et cetera. Was, was that, was that quality, or that degree of musical quality, present in Detroit at the time you were, you had just gotten your saxophone?

Yes, at that time, when I was 18, 19, there were people like um...Lamont Hamilton, who played tenor [saxophone], Moon Mullins [sp.]–both of which lived on the west side–um...Johnny Trafton. I don’t know if you’ve heard.
